---
title: Every chart type and rich block in one report
description: A synthetic fixture for the RichView lockdown. It exercises all nine chart types, every rich block and one deliberately invalid fence, so each builtin style can be compared on the same evidence.
version: 0.0.1
author: RichView lockdown fixture
date: 2026-10-21
---

All values below are synthetic. They exist only to show how the renderer at commit `b4db233` draws each element.

### Interval

```chart
type: interval
title: Only the redesign test clears the 2% target
subtitle: Conversion uplift with authored 90% ranges, synthetic
data:
  inline:
    - {test: Redesign, low: 0.021, high: 0.058, uplift: 0.039}
    - {test: Pricing page, low: -0.012, high: 0.031, uplift: 0.009}
    - {test: Onboarding email, low: -0.004, high: 0.026, uplift: 0.011}
    - {test: Checkout copy, low: -0.020, high: 0.015, uplift: -0.003}
encoding: {x: test, y: uplift, lower: low, upper: high}
axes:
  y: {label: Conversion uplift, format: percent}
annotations:
  - {kind: line, at: {y: 0.02}, text: Target}
```

## Rich blocks

### Table

```table
data:
  inline:
    - {plan: Solo, region: Europe, accounts: 1840, revenue: 412000, churn: 0.031}
    - {plan: Solo, region: North America, accounts: 2210, revenue: 538000, churn: 0.028}
    - {plan: Team, region: Europe, accounts: 640, revenue: 905000, churn: 0.019}
    - {plan: Team, region: North America, accounts: 810, revenue: 1214000, churn: 0.017}
    - {plan: Team, region: APAC, accounts: 300, revenue: 388000, churn: 0.024}
    - {plan: Enterprise, region: Europe, accounts: 42, revenue: 1630000, churn: 0.008}
    - {plan: Enterprise, region: North America, accounts: 57, revenue: 2275000, churn: 0.006}
    - {plan: Enterprise, region: APAC, accounts: 18, revenue: 590000, churn: 0.011}
columns:
  - {key: plan, label: Plan}
  - {key: region, label: Region}
  - {key: accounts, label: Accounts, format: number, align: right}
  - {key: revenue, label: Revenue, format: currency, align: right}
  - {key: churn, label: Monthly churn, format: percent, align: right}
sort: {key: revenue, dir: desc}
max_rows: 5
total: true
```

*Note: five rows show by default; the remaining three sit behind the disclosure.*

### Callouts

```callout
kind: up
title: Retention improved.
body: Twelve-month retention rose to 91% after the onboarding change.
```

```callout
kind: down
title: Margin slipped.
body: Hosting costs grew faster than revenue in September.
```

```callout
kind: neutral
title: Method.
body: Every figure in this fixture is synthetic and exists only to exercise the renderer.
```

```callout
kind: hold
title: Sample size caveat.
body: Only twelve weeks of post-launch data are available.
```

## An invalid block

The next fence is deliberately invalid: `donut` is not a chart type. RichView keeps the source visible and records a diagnostic instead of dropping the block.

```chart
type: donut
title: An unsupported chart type stays visible as source
data:
  inline:
    - {slice: A, value: 1}
encoding: {x: slice, y: value}
```
